info.title: Ophiolite public API
info.description: One public API for every project operation. Three credential kinds reach it: the browser session (opaque HttpOnly cookie plus the X-CSRF-Token proof and, on non-GET requests, the exact Origin), a project-scoped delegate lasting at most five minutes (Bearer oph_api_..., parent session and current native permissions remain mandatory), and a browser-approved provider grant (Bearer provider token plus X-Ophiolite-Application-Grant; capability 1: the scientific read resources and the applications route within its read/write scopes; capability 3 adds reading wells, wellbores and lineage and the LAS upload routes). A request that carries an Authorization header is a machine request and is refused with MACHINE_AUTH_REQUIRED when a cookie or Origin travels with it. Scope and capability are ceilings; every operation runs the same native permission checks whoever calls it. Not a stable SDK or unattended service-account contract.
